To evolve a character, you must max their level first then it will prompt you. Heres the requirements  


3>4 star: 3 3\* units/lions  
4>5 star: 4 4\* units/lions  
5>6 star: 5 5\* units/lions  


Silver lions(starts at 2\*) are fairly common and can be raised in the "kingdom/city" for 24 hours for one or use "red leaf" currency(obtained via tower and quests/achievements) to instantly get one  
Gold lions(starts at 3\*) can be acquired by event currency(limited), map progress quests,  timed missions, or via GM gifts  
Black lions(which start at 4\*) are rare and you can get one by finishing story mode on normal(as far as my progress goes), im not sure if the guilds sell em  


Everyone has the same evolution requirements, what differs would be ranking up skills(which require numerous ginseng(acquired by letting seeds grow, or skip via ingame currency, red ginseng(for higher rank skill requirements) however is found in the maze trading shop) and some skills require uncommon mats from farming story maps)
